about: The harness's agent team: one Lead (the agent in the chat) and nine specialists it delegates to. scripts/team.py validates plans, guards delegation, briefs specialists, takes handoffs and runs post-checks from this file; scripts/gen_agents.py writes .pi/agents/<name>.md from it.

areas.sources: loading data: sources, S3 folders, streams (bronze)
areas.model: facts, dimensions, keys, joins, calendar, descriptions
areas.ml: datasets for ML, ML models, training, scoring; optimisers (the best plan within limits) and their runs
areas.release: commits, documentation, release notes, publish and promote preparation, operations health
areas.exports: board packs: one-pagers, PDF/PPTX/PNG documents, data extracts and explainer videos, checked before they go out

data-engineer.description: Brings data in and builds the medallion layers: bronze sources (files, S3 folders, streams), silver cleaning and combining, gold facts and dimensions; reconciles each layer.

analytics-engineer.description: Builds the semantic model on gold (kinds, keys, joins, calendar, descriptions) until Ready, and the measures and glossary from the vault's definitions.

analyst.description: Answers questions and builds reports and dashboards from the model; segments before concluding; read-only except reports.

ml-engineer.description: Builds datasets for ML, forecasts, anomaly and segment models; trains and scores them; reports accuracy against the baseline. Sets up optimisers (the best plan within limits: hours, units, slots) and runs them: a plan is a proposal the person approves.

automation-engineer.description: Builds flows: schedules, digests, alerts, deliveries and failure alerts, saved switched off.

agent-builder.description: Builds ABI custom agents and tools with narrow scope, tested tools and evaluation sets.

reviewer.description: Checks the others' work before release, read-only: measures against the vault, counts across layers, report figures against queries, flows off. Reports findings; changes nothing.

release-ops.description: Version control, documentation and operations: groups and commits the work with clear messages, writes release notes from the journal, prepares publish and promotion, checks refresh, data quality, flow runs and stream health.

board-pack.description: Prepares what management takes to a board review: picks the reports and pages, builds a one-pager report when asked, writes the commentary with every number from ABI, checks periods, totals and definitions, and renders the pack (documents, data extracts, an explainer video). Never sends anything.
